On the $1.2B investment in Skydio, Hamblin said investors "may have a mixed view of the incremental investment which further ties Axon to a singular player in the rapidly evolving drone technology industry."

Piper Sandler analyst James Fish called Q3 "arguably Axon's worst quarter as a public company following 3Q25's debacle.
